LanguageData.AA_CK_SettingsScope: These settings apply to all saves and take effect after restarting RimWorld. Existing Vanilla Expanded Framework choices are preserved.
LanguageData.AA_CK_UniversalHelp: Default: off. Removes the five universal pieces that use placeholder art. Species-specific equipment stays available. After restarting, disabled pieces already in saves will be missing: store a backup before enabling this option.
LanguageData.AA_CK_RelicsHelp: Default: on. Prevents newly selected relics from using this animal apparel when Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Relics and Artifacts is active. Existing relics are not converted.
LanguageData.AA_CK_RelicsUnavailable: Requires Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Relics and Artifacts. Your saved choice is retained while that mod is inactive.
